output.recommendation: A global channel should be established for AI-driven network operators to promptly notify emergency dispatch services of any faults affecting 911 or similar emergency call delivery, mirroring the requirement in [G1] US-47CFR-PART4 § 4.9(h)(4) which mandates notification within 30 minutes of discovering an outage.
output.rationale: This recommendation aligns with existing global standards and practices by ensuring that AI-driven network operators have a clear, timely channel to inform emergency services about potential disruptions in emergency call delivery, thereby closing the coordination gap identified.
